name: Rolls-Royce Holdings plc
content: Rolls-Royce Holdings plc is a pre-eminent engineering company focused on world-class power and propulsion systems. The company operates through three core divisions: Civil Aerospace, Defense, and Power Systems. It is a leading provider of aircraft engines for the commercial and military sectors, as well as marine propulsion and energy solutions. With a focus on innovation and sustainability, Rolls-Royce is at the forefront of developing net-zero power solutions and advanced technologies for the global aerospace and defense markets, maintaining a significant presence in over 50 countries.

tabs.label: Management
tabs.content:
Officers

Tufan Erginbilgic(Date: 2023 January)

Chief Executive Officer

Tufan joined Rolls-Royce as Chief Executive Officer on 1 January 2023. He has a background in engineering and spent over 20 years at BP, including five years as a member of its executive team. His last role at BP was as CEO of Downstream. He has also held several non-executive directorships in heavy industry and manufacturing companies.

Helen McCabe(Date: 2023 September)

Chief Financial Officer

Helen joined Rolls-Royce as Chief Financial Officer on 1 September 2023. She was previously Senior Vice President, Finance for the Customer & Products division at BP. She has more than 25 years of experience in senior finance and leadership roles within the energy sector.

Directors

Anita Frew(Date: 2021 October)

Chair

Anita was appointed to the Board in July 2021 and became Chair in October 2021. She has extensive experience in board leadership across various sectors including chemicals, engineering, and finance. She is also the Chair of Croda International Plc.

Tufan Erginbilgic(Date: 2023 January)

Executive Director

Tufan joined Rolls-Royce as Chief Executive Officer on 1 January 2023. He has a background in engineering and spent over 20 years at BP, including five years as a member of its executive team.

Helen McCabe(Date: 2023 September)

Executive Director

Helen joined Rolls-Royce as Chief Financial Officer on 1 September 2023. She has more than 25 years of experience in senior finance and leadership roles.

Panos Kakoullis(Date: 2021 May)

Independent Non-Executive Director

Panos joined the Board in May 2021. He was previously a partner at Deloitte where he spent over 30 years, including as Managing Director of the Global Audit & Assurance business.

Dame Angela Strank(Date: 2020 May)

Independent Non-Executive Director

Angela joined the Board in May 2020. She has over 35 years of experience in the energy industry, primarily with BP, where she held various senior leadership and technology roles.

Jørgen Madsen Lindemann(Date: 2022 March)

Independent Non-Executive Director

Jørgen joined the Board in March 2022. He is the CEO of SAS AB and has extensive experience in the media and digital sectors, having previously served as President and CEO of Modern Times Group.

Beverly Goulet(Date: 2017 July)

Independent Non-Executive Director

Beverly joined the Board in July 2017. She has significant experience in the airline industry, having held senior roles at American Airlines, including Senior Vice President and Chief Integration Officer.
